volume_formula: V0=xenon_volume_cm3/0.087; native a_V in Bq/m3; displayed Xe concentrations multiply by 1000

truth_construction.description: One unchanged joint nonnegative Poisson ML fit to original SAMPLE-role SPIKE, GASBK, DETBK. Set only fresh Xe indices 1:5 of its physical estimate to exact zero; retain fresh Rn, all five memory coordinates, and all seven fitted DETBK means. No null refit.
truth_construction.detector_background: Same DETBK source file as previous study; generating zeta is the jointly fitted value, not a new measured background and not the unadjusted raw counts

warnings: Ограниченная оценка: обычная обратная информационная матрица не является её ковариацией
Для ограниченного метода ν=N−ранг — номинальное число степеней свободы; при активных ограничениях стандартное χ²-распределение неприменимо.

generator: All 21 SAMPLE/GASBK/DETBK ROI counts are independent Poisson(mu0), same realization used by both methods

weights.wls: W=diag(1/where(x==0,1,x)); recomputed from every realization, all 21 original ROI counts
weights.nnls: Identical criterion and weights as WLS; nonnegativity on all physical [a_V; gamma; zeta]
weights.zero_counts: Only the WLS variance of a zero count is replaced by 1; x remains zero; Poisson uses original zeros

optimizer.settings: Existing defaults; no overrides or algorithm changes

lc_rule: For each method one corresponding nonnegative auxiliary fit per realization; remove each tested fresh Xe contribution from its expected mean in turn, retain all other fitted coordinates, use existing full-model covariance to calculate LC at alpha=.05. No null refit. Detect iff free a_V_i > LC_i. Native Bq/m3; both multiply by 1000 for output. No c multiplier.
missing_policy: Keep every generated realization and failure reason; no replacement or selection. A missing free-fit covariance alone does not invalidate an available free estimate and LC.
calibration_warnings: Радон: явно выбран режим legacy — эффективность 0.3 и поправка по периоду Rn222 из старого проекта. Это приближение, не отдельная калибровка радоновой цепочки; оно влияет и на перенос памяти.
memory_units_note: gamma is a GASBK reference-ROI expected-count coordinate, not concentration; gamma is retained without volume conversion
time_zone_note: File timestamps are naive as parsed; no timezone conversion is applied
